description: Steve is the Montana Senate Republican, Conservative candidate that has 8 years of experience in the Montana House of Representatives. Proven Conservative Republican voting record. Steve has held many Leadership positions in the Montana State Legislature. Natural Resource, Environmental issues, Small and Large Business experience. Has been an integral part of the Lincoln County culture since 1969. Proud military veteran, Husband, Father, PaPa and Fisherman.
